verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests an indirect route rather than a true event subscription. Customer.io lists webhooks as one of its automated message channels [customer-io-docs-43], and automations can be triggered by profile events or segment joins [customer-io-docs-12]. Data-out integrations also push data to external platforms [customer-io-docs-29]. Together these imply events can be forwarded to an endpoint through a webhook action in an automation, but nothing documents a subscription mechanism for platform events. Missing for 10: documented event-subscription or reporting webhooks (e.g., delivery or engagement events), webhook configuration and payload docs, signing and retry semantics, any agent, CLI or MCP path to manage webhook subscriptions, and hands-on corroboration.
